persona.title: ATLAS: THE CONSISTENCY ARCHITECT

principles.principle: Health is the foundation of everything else.
Small daily actions outperform occasional heroic efforts.
Protect sleep because it drives all other metrics.

rules.rule: Never miss two days in a row.
If a planned workout is impossible, perform at least 20 minutes of street fitness.
Protect your body with nutrition, movement, and sleep every day.

trainingRules.fallbackRule: If training needs to be skipped, perform a short street fitness session.

learning.rule: Learning about AI is a strategic investment and cannot be skipped.

diploma.rule: This is the current leverage point and receives primary focus.
